Aisha (Finance): FYI — APAC invoice APAC-2026-03 shows a missing credit memo. Net GPU spend is ~85% higher than expected after credits. link: https://invoices.redwood.ai/APAC-2026-03.pdf :eyes:
Tom (CloudOps): which line item? dev vs prod pools?
Aisha (Finance): line 42-44, shows charge for `playground-asia-gpu` but CM-834 (credit memo) applied to `redwood-asia` account. looks like an account id mismatch.
Diego (ML Infra): that `playground-asia` is a sandbox pool — we had a multi-tenant migration last week, possible tag rename.
billing-bot: Automated alert: CM-834 not applied. Failure reason: account_id mismatch (expected: `redwood-asia`, found: `redwood-prod-asia`). Ticket: #BILL-918.
Aisha (Finance): copying the invoice CSV extract:```
account_id,resource,amount,credit_memo
redwood-prod-asia,playground-asia-gpu,17234.50,
redwood-asia,prod-asia-gpu, -17234.50,CM-834
```
Sofia (Accounting): can you attach the original CM request? need GL code and approval chain to process an AR adjustment. @Aisha
Aisha (Finance): uploaded CM request here: https://docs.redwood.ai/CM-834-request. Approvals: finance-manager + head of platform required.
Tom (CloudOps): temporary remediation: can we re-tag that playground consumption to `redwood-asia:temp-reassign` and then backfill tags for Mar 1-7? Does billing accept backfilled tags?
Sofia (Accounting): we can accept backfilled tags if we have signed approval and evidence. backfill window closes EOD Friday.
Diego (ML Infra): tagging script ready, but need the exact mapping. Aisha, can you confirm which accounts to apply to?
Aisha (Finance): Confirm map: `redwood-prod-asia` -> `redwood-asia` for March 1-7 only. I'll start approval chain now.
billing-bot: Note: Running revalidation after backfill may take up to 24h.
Sofia (Accounting): Once approvals are in, I can issue an AR credit to offset the net. Please include the invoice # and CM reference in the approval email.
Tom (CloudOps): I'll queue the tag backfill run at 2100 UTC tonight :thumbsup:
Aisha (Finance): Action items: 1) I will request approvals (Sofia), 2) Tom runs backfill (Diego to supervise), 3) billing team revalidate CM-834 after backfill (billing-bot). Estimated resolution: 48-72h.
Diego (ML Infra): noted. will keep a live log in #eng-infra if anything fails.
Sofia (Accounting): :pray: Please BCC me on approval email so I can move AR once it clears.
Aisha (Finance): will do. tagging the ticket #BILL-918 and pinging legal for any memo wording issues.
Tom (CloudOps): :eyes: good to have this before close.
billing-bot: Status update will post to this thread after revalidation complete.
